hook: *Instant pension* now reaches dialysis patients, weavers and toddy tappers.
hook_b: *Instant pension* now reaches dialysis patients, weavers and toddy tappers.
tldr: Telangana has extended its instant pension facility beyond the old-age category for women, to more groups of families.

beats.what: Per The Hindu, the decision benefits families of persons with disabilities, toddy tappers, handloom weavers, dialysis patients and those affected by HIV and filariasis.
beats.why: The facility, so far tied to the old-age category for women, now reaches households that earlier had to wait.
beats.care: If someone in your family fits a listed group, check eligibility at the local mandal or ward office.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Groups now covered, per The Hindu: persons with disabilities, toddy tappers, handloom weavers, dialysis patients, people affected by HIV and filariasis. Amounts and application steps were not in the summary; check the government order.

cards.q: Instant pension now covers more groups. Is this enough?
opts: Getting it is the hard part

cards.q: Which group is covered by the expanded instant pension?
cards.why: Toddy tappers are listed among the newly covered groups.

learn.t: Instant pension means a pension granted quickly on a pre-set eligibility category instead of a long verification wait.

watch: The official GO for amounts and how to apply.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Telangana extends 'Instant pension' facility beyond old-age pension category for women

insight: Earlier it covered only the old-age category for women.
